This Telegram bot template combines aiogram 3, Django 5, and Celery. It is a starter scaffold with `/start` and user tracking, designed for extension.

Commands:
cp .env.example .env  # Then edit .env with your values
uv run python manage.py migrate
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py runserver
uv run python main.py
uv run celery -A config worker --loglevel=info
uv run python manage.py makemigrations
uv run python manage.py test
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py shell

`.env`: `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` and `DJANGO_SECRET_KEY` are required; `CELERY_BROKER_URL` configures Redis; `START_COMMAND_MESSAGE` customizes `/start`.

`main.py` initializes Django ORM, configures aiogram, registers middleware/routes, and polls Telegram. `config/` provides Django settings, database configuration via `dj-database-url` (SQLite default), Celery, and admin. `bot/models.py` contains `TelegramUser`; `bot/aiogram/handlers.py` contains handlers; `bot/aiogram/middlewares.py` contains `UserTrackingMiddleware`; `bot/tasks.py` contains Celery tasks.

Add handlers to `bot/aiogram/handlers.py` or router modules included at `main.py:42`. Add models to `bot/models.py` and register them in `bot/admin.py`. Implement Celery tasks in `bot/tasks.py` using the `<REDACTED_USER>_task` decorator. Add environment variables to `.env.example` and access them via `config/settings.py`.

All commands should use `uv run python`. Django admin is at `/admin`. User interactions are automatically tracked. Celery requires Redis. Proper secret management and database configuration are required.
